definition.title: Native base video plus an exact correction stream
definition.source_excerpt: Prepare a supported base representation and signed corrections to recover declared source samples. Exactness requires identical base reconstruction and specified upsampling; charge correction size, production and GPU reconstruction.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Specify one concrete wrong-output or provenance failure the proposed tool must detect beyond the existing harness.
definition.minimum_probe: Inject that failure in a tiny known-good fixture, demonstrate detection and run an unchanged control; do not build a general research platform.
definition.initial_screen: Specify one concrete wrong-output or provenance failure the proposed tool must detect beyond the existing harness. Inject that failure in a tiny known-good fixture, demonstrate detection and run an unchanged control; do not build a general research platform.
definition.primary_metric: Decision power, reproducibility or diagnostic cost without changing the measured player outcome.
definition.scope_contract: Independent known truth plus a specific expected observation, not self-reported counters from the candidate.
definition.negative_control: A different failure, stale source/hash or malformed record must not count as the intended finding.
definition.stop_boundary: No dashboard, generic planner or broad testing framework. Retain a small reproducible assertion and move to the next item.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing fixtures and minimal observation surface; instrumentation overhead must be recorded separately.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
